scripts.build:ctty-helper: mkdir -p dist && cc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O2 -o dist/ctty-helper src/terminal/pty/station-ctty-helper.c && chmod 0755 dist/ctty-helper
scripts.station:profile: bun run link:station && bun run repair:node-pty && STATION_PROFILE=1 bun src/main.tsx
scripts.station:devtools: bun run link:station && bun run repair:node-pty && DEV=true bun src/main.tsx
scripts.e2e:persist: bun run link:station && bun run repair:node-pty && bun src/host/e2eReattachDemo.ts
scripts.host:dev: bun run link:station && bun run repair:node-pty && bun src/host/e2eReattachDemo.ts --dev --hold
scripts.test:agents: bun run repair:node-pty && STATION_PTY_SMOKE=1 STATION_PTY_SMOKE_TUI=1 bun test src/input/stationInput.e2e.test.tsx src/terminal/ptyPipeline.smoke.test.ts
scripts.test:pty: bun run repair:node-pty && STATION_PTY_SMOKE=1 bun test src/terminal/pty/test/childPtyEnvironment.test.ts src/terminal/pty/test/localPtyTerminal.test.ts src/terminal/pty/test/auxShellPlacement.test.ts src/terminal/ptyPipeline.smoke.test.ts src/host/ptyTable.smoke.test.ts src/terminal/pty/test/hostReplaySizing.test.ts src/terminal/pty/test/localPtyBridgeHardening.test.ts src/terminal/pty/test/localPtyBridgeOrphan.test.ts src/host/ptyTableRegistry.test.ts src/host/orphanBridges.test.ts src/host/orphanAdoption.smoke.test.ts src/host/hostHandoff.smoke.test.ts src/host/hostHandoff.packaging.smoke.test.ts src/input/stationInput.e2e.test.tsx
scripts.test:host:upgrade: bun run repair:node-pty && STATION_PTY_SMOKE=1 bun test src/host/hostHandoff.smoke.test.ts src/host/hostHandoff.packaging.smoke.test.ts
scripts.test:pty:bun: bun run build:ctty-helper && STATION_PTY_SMOKE=1 STATION_PTY_IMPL=bun bun test src/terminal/pty/test/terminalProcessEmitter.test.ts src/terminal/pty/test/childPtyEnvironment.test.ts src/terminal/pty/test/localPtyTerminal.test.ts src/terminal/pty/test/auxShellPlacement.test.ts src/terminal/pty/test/bunTerminalProcess.test.ts src/host/ptyTable.smoke.test.ts src/terminal/pty/test/hostReplaySizing.test.ts src/host/ptyTableRegistry.test.ts src/host/orphanBridges.test.ts
